Maya R: RC candidate rc-2026-03-21-7 ready for origination. Artifacts pinned at sha 3f9a2c. Requesting signoffs, sheriff, and KV-warm before canary. Change window 21:00-22:00 UTC.
Sam (infra): ack, infra looks good. I'll pin routing config to v2 and prepare KV warm. Please add QA smoke checklist link.
Olivia - QA: starting smoke now — streaming, tokenization, embeddings. Will report in ~15.
deploy-bot: origination request accepted and queued at 21:05 UTC. Command:
```
/promote rc-2026-03-21-7 --pin=3f9a2c --canary=5 --kv-warm
```
Jun - oncall: I'll take sheriff. Rollback criteria: revert traffic to baseline sha 1a2b3c if error rate > 1.5% or p95 latency > 250ms sustained > 5m. Pager escalation on spike :pager:.
Alex: release notes posted https://notion.redwood/rc-2026-03-21-7-release-notes — highlights a small rerank tuning and a docs-only schema change.
Maya R: confirmed pin -> 3f9a2c. Sam please kick KV warm pre-canary.
Sam (infra): kicking KV warm in 10m. KV warm job id: kv-7745. Logs: https://logs.redwood/kv-7745
deploy-bot: canary started at 21:07 UTC (5% traffic). Metrics snapshot: p95=120ms, errors=0.2%.
Olivia - QA: smoke pass 1. Found minor formatting regression in rerank output — filing ticket INC-4321. Not blocking promo if team wants to patch post-deploy. Recommend hold at 25% for 10m to observe.
Maya R: agree with 25% hold. Tagging eng-runtime for eyeballs.
Alex: docs fix tracked, not user-facing.
Jun - oncall: ack. Monitoring dashboards up; I'll hit rollback immediately if errors exceed threshold.
Sam (infra): after 10m hold and green metrics I'll widen to 100% and flip the feature flag for full rollout.
deploy-bot: widened to 25% at 21:12 UTC. Canary hold in effect.
deploy-bot: hold complete, metrics stable. No alerts.
Sam (infra): promoting to 100% now and flipping dbflag darklaunch -> off.
deploy-bot: promotion to 100% complete at 21:25 UTC. All nodes report healthy.
Maya R: PROD promotion complete. Summary: pinned sha 3f9a2c, canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%, KV warm performed, rollback target sha 1a2b3c. Rollback command if needed:
```
/promote rollback --to-sha=1a2b3c --reason="prod-regression"
```
Maya R: tagging follow-ups: INC-4321 for rerank formatting, postmortem if rollback occurs. Great job team :tada:
